translations.web: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
translations.bsb: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
translations.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
translations.asv: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.
